run_asynchronous_engine: run the Asynchronous engine to execute concurrent observe-act loops for multiple player entities
create_asynchronous_instance: create an Asynchronous engine instance with custom call prompts and sleep time settings
pause_resume_simulation: pause and resume all player threads in the Asynchronous engine using pause and play methods
resolve_entity_action: resolve a putative event by observing it in the game master and getting the resolved outcome
check_termination: check if the simulation should terminate by querying the game master with a termination prompt
